<robot name="desk_0_84x0_76x0_67">
  <link name="world"/>
  <!-- -------------------- Parameters (implicit) -------------------- -->
  <!-- Desk overall: W=0.84m (X), H=0.76m (Z), D=0.67m (Y). -->
  <!-- Origin at floor under middle: x=0, y=0 at center, z=0. Front faces -Y. -->

  <!-- -------------------- Geometry sizes -------------------- -->
  <!-- Top: thickness 0.04m -->
  <!-- Legs: 0.06m square cross section, height 0.72m (76-4 cm top) -->
  <!-- Drawer: opening under top; approx front-to-back depth 0.50m, width 0.76m -->
  <!-- Drawer slides out toward front (-Y). -->

  <!-- ==================== Top ==================== -->
  <link name="top_link">
    <inertial>
      <!-- approx mass 20 kg -->
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="20.0"/>
      <!-- inertia for a rectangular box about its center: (1/12)m(y^2+z^2), (1/12)m(x^2+z^2), (1/12)m(x^2+y^2)
           x=0.84, y=0.67, z=0.04 -->
      <inertia ixx="0.7657333333" iyy="0.7657333333" izz="1.2546666667" cx="0" cy="0" cz="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.72" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.84 0.67 0.04"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_top">
        <color rgba="0.55 0.37 0.22 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.72" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.84 0.67 0.04"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- ==================== Inner frame ==================== -->
  <link name="frame_link">
    <inertial>
      <!-- approx mass 18 kg -->
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="18.0"/>
      <!-- Treat as a box occupying (width 0.84, depth 0.62, height 0.68) centered at z=0.38.
           x=0.84, y=0.62, z=0.68 -->
      <inertia ixx="2.0583360000" iyy="2.4836160000" izz="4.57152" cx="0" cy="0" cz="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.38" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.84 0.62 0.68"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_frame">
        <color rgba="0.50 0.33 0.20 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0.38" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.84 0.62 0.68"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <!-- Fixed joints to assembly -->
  <joint name="world_to_top" type="fixed">
    <parent link="world"/>
    <child link="top_link"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <joint name="world_to_frame" type="fixed">
    <parent link="world"/>
    <child link="frame_link"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- ==================== Legs (4) ==================== -->
  <!-- Leg size: 0.06 x 0.06 x 0.72; placed with feet at z=0 -->
  <!-- Half offsets: width/2=0.42, depth/2=0.335 -->
  <!-- Use small margins so legs sit near corners but inside edges: -->
  <!-- Leg centers at x=±0.39, y=±0.305 -->
  <link name="leg_fl_link">
    <inertial>
      <!-- mass 4.0 kg -->
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="4.0"/>
      <!-- Box inertia about center; x=0.06, y=0.06, z=0.72 -->
      <inertia ixx="0.0824" iyy="0.0824" izz="0.00192" cx="0" cy="0" cz="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.39 0.305 0.36" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.72"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_leg">
        <color rgba="0.45 0.30 0.18 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.39 0.305 0.36" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.72"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <link name="leg_fr_link">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="4.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.0824" iyy="0.0824" izz="0.00192" cx="0" cy="0" cz="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.39 0.305 0.36" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.72"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_leg"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.39 0.305 0.36" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.72"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <link name="leg_bl_link">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="4.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.0824" iyy="0.0824" izz="0.00192" cx="0" cy="0" cz="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0.39 -0.305 0.36" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.72"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_leg"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0.39 -0.305 0.36" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.72"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <link name="leg_br_link">
    <inertial>
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="4.0"/>
      <inertia ixx="0.0824" iyy="0.0824" izz="0.00192" cx="0" cy="0" cz="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="-0.39 -0.305 0.36" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.72"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_leg"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="-0.39 -0.305 0.36" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.06 0.06 0.72"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <joint name="world_to_leg_fl" type="fixed">
    <parent link="world"/>
    <child link="leg_fl_link"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>
  <joint name="world_to_leg_fr" type="fixed">
    <parent link="world"/>
    <child link="leg_fr_link"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>
  <joint name="world_to_leg_bl" type="fixed">
    <parent link="world"/>
    <child link="leg_bl_link"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>
  <joint name="world_to_leg_br" type="fixed">
    <parent link="world"/>
    <child link="leg_br_link"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- ==================== Drawer slider guide (optional, fixed solid) ==================== -->
  <link name="drawer_backplate_link">
    <inertial>
      <!-- mass 3 kg -->
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="3.0"/>
      <!-- approximate box: width 0.76, depth 0.02, height 0.18; centered at z=0.44, y ~ 0.20 (behind drawer start) -->
      <!-- x=0.76, y=0.02, z=0.18 -->
      <inertia ixx="0.0016152" iyy="0.1957080" izz="0.0864" cx="0" cy="0" cz="0"/>
    </inertial>
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 0.235 0.44" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.76 0.02 0.18"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="wood_frame"/>
    </visual>
    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.235 0.44" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.76 0.02 0.18"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>
  </link>

  <joint name="world_to_drawer_backplate" type="fixed">
    <parent link="world"/>
    <child link="drawer_backplate_link"/>
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
  </joint>

  <!-- ==================== Drawer (moving) ==================== -->
  <!-- Drawer size: width 0.76, depth 0.50, height 0.18 -->
  <!-- Drawer bottom sits roughly at z=0.34..0.52. -->
  <!-- Place drawer "fully closed" such that its center y is at y_closed. -->
  <!-- With front facing -Y: closed should put drawer mostly in cabinet (toward +Y). -->
  <!-- Let cabinet interior front be around y = -0.305, back around y = +0.235 -->
  <!-- Drawer length (center extent): depth/2=0.25 -->
  <!-- Closed: drawer front edge at y=-0.205 (still inside), so center y = -0.205 + 0.25 = 0.045 -->
  <!-- Range: slide out toward -Y by up to 0.20m, so y ranges [0.045, -0.155]. -->
  <link name="drawer_link">
    <inertial>
      <!-- mass 6 kg -->
      <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <mass value="6.0"/>
      <!-- Box inertia x=0.76, y=0.50, z=0.18 about center -->
      <!-- Ixx=(1/12)m(y^2+z^2) -->
      <!-- = (1/12)*6*((0.50^2)+(0.18^2)) = 0.5*(0.25+0.0324)=0.1412 -->
      <!-- Iyy=(1/12)m(x^2+z^2)=0.5*(0.5776+0.0324)=0.305 -->
      <!-- Izz=(1/12)m(x^2+y^2)=0.5*(0.5776+0.25)=0.4138 -->
      <inertia ixx="0.1412" iyy="0.3050" izz="0.4138" cx="0" cy="0" cz="0"/>
    </inertial>

    <visual>
      <!-- Use joint origin at the drawer's closed center position plus variable translation along Y -->
      <origin xyz="0 0.045 0.43" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.76 0.50 0.18"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="drawer_wood">
        <color rgba="0.46 0.30 0.18 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>

    <collision>
      <origin xyz="0 0.045 0.43" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.76 0.50 0.18"/>
      </geometry>
    </collision>

    <!-- Drawer handle (small) -->
    <visual>
      <origin xyz="0 -0.17 0.49" rpy="0 0 0"/>
      <geometry>
        <box size="0.76 0.02 0.02"/>
      </geometry>
      <material name="handle_metal">
        <color rgba="0.3 0.3 0.32 1"/>
      </material>
    </visual>
  </link>

  <joint name="drawer_slide_joint" type="prismatic">
    <parent link="world"/>
    <child link="drawer_link"/>
    <!-- Prismatic axis aligned with Y (positive toward back). Slides out toward front = negative Y. -->
    <origin xyz="0 0 0" rpy="0 0 0"/>
    <axis xyz="0 -1 0"/>
    <!-- Limit using axis direction: axis is (0,-1,0), so positive joint motion moves toward -Y -->
    <!-- Convert desired y positions with variable s where translation = -s along Y -->
    <!-- We defined drawer center y at 0.045 for closed. Desired open center y=-0.155 (delta=-0.200). -->
    <!-- Along axis (0,-1,0): increasing joint moves drawer by +s along -Y, i.e. y = 0.045 - s.
         Open: -0.155 = 0.045 - s => s = 0.200 -->
    <limit lower="0.0" upper="0.2" effort="50" velocity="2"/>
  </joint>
</robot>
